workspace.home.description: This is your own workspace: what needs you, your recent investigations, and the services behind them. The incident and investigation services are not connected yet, so this page shows no count, no timeline and no conclusion.
workspace.home.platform.description: The build this browser is talking to, as the kernel reports it.
workspace.home.platform.loading.descript: Waiting for the kernel's version probe.
workspace.home.platform.loading.title: Reading the version
workspace.home.platform.notFound.descrip: The probe answered 404: this kernel predates the endpoint. The version stays unknown instead of being defaulted.
workspace.home.platform.notFound.title: This kernel has no version endpoint
workspace.home.platform.stale.descriptio: The version below comes from the last successful read; later probes did not answer.
workspace.home.platform.stale.title: The last read is out of date
workspace.home.platform.title: Platform version
workspace.home.platform.unavailable.desc: The kernel did not answer the version probe, so the version is unknown.
workspace.home.plugins.description: Entries this session was actually granted, as the server shipped them.
workspace.home.plugins.empty.description: The server answered with an extension list that has no entry for this surface.
workspace.home.plugins.empty.title: No business plugin contributes an entry
workspace.home.plugins.forbidden.descrip: The server rejected the request (403). Ask a platform administrator for the matching permission.
workspace.home.plugins.forbidden.title: Not allowed to read the entries
workspace.home.plugins.loading.descripti: Waiting for the server's extension list.
workspace.home.plugins.loading.title: Reading the entries
workspace.home.plugins.partial.descripti: The list is live, but at least one entry could not be loaded. Only the entries below really open.
workspace.home.plugins.partial.title: Only part of the entries loaded
workspace.home.plugins.title: Business plugin entries
workspace.home.plugins.unavailable.descr: The request failed or an entry could not be loaded. Nothing is listed rather than guessed.
workspace.home.plugins.unavailable.title: The entries could not be read
workspace.home.surface.description: You are in the Business workspace. Platform upkeep lives in the platform console, not here.
workspace.home.surface.noAdmin: This account has no platform-console access. Ask a platform administrator if you need it.
workspace.home.surface.title: Current surface
workspace.home.taskSpace.description: Each area below states what it will show and which interface it is still missing. Until that interface exists, no area carries a number: a count of zero would be a claim about your incidents that nothing supports.
workspace.home.taskSpace.title: Your task space
workspace.incidents.description: The incident list and the investigation workspace behind it. The incident service is not connected yet, so this page shows the layout it will use and no event, timeline or conclusion.
workspace.incidents.layout.description: Desktop-first: timeline and evidence on the left, hypotheses and tools in the middle, detail on the right. Every region is an empty slot until the incident service answers.
workspace.incidents.layout.title: Investigation workspace
workspace.notYet.description: This page is a placeholder for a capability that does not exist yet. It shows no sample incident, no generated conclusion and no substitute data.
workspace.notYet.empty.description: When the capability ships this page will read the API behind it; until then it stays empty on purpose.
workspace.notYet.empty.title: Nothing to show yet
workspace.notYet.incidents.missing: an Incident domain model and its query API (the domain ADR is still open)
workspace.notYet.investigations.missing: the investigation, evidence and human-verdict workflow API
workspace.notYet.observability.missing: a scoped metrics, trace and log query API with per-surface authorization
workspace.notYet.reports.missing: report storage and the human-verdict review flow
workspace.notYet.resources.missing: a resource topology model and its authorization scope
workspace.notYet.sources.missing: a business data-source registry with connection status
workspace.region.analysis.plan: Working hypotheses and the query tools used against them. Model output stays labelled a proposal - never a conclusion.
workspace.region.detail.plan: The selected incident's identity, scope and verdict trail.
workspace.region.emptyHint: Nothing renders here until the incident service exists. This slot never shows sample events.
workspace.region.timeline.plan: Ordered events, each carrying its evidence link and collection status.
workspace.tasks.awaiting.description: Incidents assigned to you, and the follow-ups that need your decision.
workspace.tasks.awaiting.title: Waiting on me
workspace.tasks.evidence.description: Collection and linkage status of the evidence each timeline depends on.
workspace.tasks.evidence.title: Evidence status
workspace.tasks.investigations.descripti: Investigations you opened or joined, newest first.
workspace.tasks.investigations.title: Recent investigations
workspace.tasks.services.description: The services behind the incidents assigned to you, and the evidence that links them.
workspace.tasks.services.scope: This area reads no platform resource list, so it states no resource total: this session may not be allowed to read one.
workspace.tasks.services.title: Related services
verify.unchanged: Submitted, but the state did not change (current: {state})
verify.readbackFailed: The write was submitted, but the state could not be re-read, so the result is unconfirmed
verify.writeFailed: The platform rejected the request and returned no reason
